oss.description: A small, fast container runtime for macOS, Windows and Linux with free Ngrok alternative
oss.readme:
A tiny, fast container runtime for macOS, Windows and Linux.
  Runs your Docker images and works with the docker CLI, Compose and buildx you already use.

  Download ·
  Features ·
  Build from source ·
  Releases

  
  
  

  🇬🇧 🇮🇩 🇩🇪 🇪🇸 🇫🇷 🇮🇹 🇵🇱 🇧🇷 🇻🇳 🇹🇷 🇷🇺 🇸🇦 🇯🇵 🇰🇷 🇨🇳 🇹🇼
  Kiri speaks 38 languages. Is yours one?

  

---

Kiri is a lightweight replacement for Docker Desktop and OrbStack, written in
Rust. It runs containers in one small Linux VM (or straight on the kernel on
Linux) and speaks the Docker Engine API, so your tools just work.

The name comes from the Igbo word *ntakịrị*, "small".

## Why Kiri

- **Fast**: a container starts and exits in about 2.5 ms through the Docker API. That's around 80 times faster than Docker Desktop.
- **Light**: the VM sleeps after 60 s idle, the daemon stays at about 15 MB, and it wakes in about 0.15 s.
- **Compatible**: `docker`, Compose, buildx, `docker login` and amd64 images through Rosetta.
- **Local domains**: `http://.kiri.local`, with HTTPS from Kiri's own certificate authority.
- **More than containers**: a one-command Kubernetes cluster and Linux machines.
- **A native window** for containers, images, volumes and networks, plus a menu bar item.
- **In your language**: 38 languages, on macOS, Windows and Linux alike.

### In your language

Kiri's window and setup come in these languages. It follows your system's language, and you can change it in Settings → Appearance. In Arabic, Persian and Central Kurdish the whole window reads right to left.

| | Language | | Language | | Language | | Language |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 🇬🇧 | English | 🇳🇴 | Norsk bokmål | 🇧🇬 | Български | 🇮🇳 | తెలుగు |
| 🇮🇩 | Bahasa Indonesia | 🇵🇱 | Polski | 🇷🇺 | Русский | 🇹🇭 | ไทย |
| 🇦🇩 | Català | 🇧🇷 | Português (Brasil) | 🇺🇦 | Українська | 🇱🇦 | ລາວ |
| 🇨🇿 | Čeština | 🇷🇴 | Română | 🇰🇿 | Қазақша | 🇯🇵 | 日本語 |
| 🇩🇪 | Deutsch | 🇦🇱 | Shqip | 🇸🇦 | العربية | 🇰🇷 | 한국어 |
| 🇪🇸 | Español | 🇸🇮 | Slovenščina | 🇮🇷 | فارسی | 🇨🇳 | 简体中文 |
| 🇫🇷 | Français | 🇫🇮 | Suomi | 🇮🇶 | کوردیی ناوەندی | 🇹🇼 | 繁體中文 |
| 🇮🇹 | Italiano | 🇻🇳 | Tiếng Việt | 🇮🇳 | हिन्दी | 🇪🇹 | አማርኛ |
| 🇱🇹 | Lietuvių | 🇹🇷 | Türkçe | 🇧🇩 | বাংলা |  |  |
| 🇭🇺 | Magyar | 🇬🇷 | Ελληνικά | 🇮🇳 | தமிழ் |  |  |

Missing yours? Translations live in [`crates/kiri/src/ui/lang`](crates/kiri/src/ui/lang); see [Contributing](#contributing).

## Install

| Platform | Get it |
|----------|--------|
| macOS 14+ (Apple silicon or Intel) | `.dmg` from [runkiri.com/releases](https://runkiri.com/releases/) |
| Windows 10 and 11 (x86-64 or Arm, through WSL 2) | `.msi` from [runkiri.com/releases](https://runkiri.com/releases/) |
| Linux (Ubuntu, Fedora and others) | `.deb` or `.rpm` from [runkiri.com/releases](https://runkiri.com/releases/) |

The first time you open Kiri, it sets up a `kiri` Docker context. Kiri updates itself, and checks each new release's signature first.

## Quick start

```sh
docker --context kiri run --rm alpine echo hello
docker --context kiri compose up -d
kiri k8s start                      # single-node Kubernetes as the `kiri` kubectl context
kiri machine create dev --distro ubuntu && kiri machine shell dev
kiri import                         # bring images, volumes and containers over from OrbStack or Docker Desktop
```

Docker's commands also work as `kiri` commands (`kiri run`, `kiri ps`,
`kiri compose up`, and so on), and always target Kiri.

## Numbers

`alpine` running `true` and removed, median of 30 runs, same `docker` CLI for all three:

|                | Docker Engine API | `docker` CLI |
|----------------|------------------:|-------------:|
| **Kiri**       | **2.55 ms**       | **14.2 ms**  |
| Docker Desktop | 213 ms            | 243 ms       |
| OrbStack       | 380 ms            | 442 ms       |

Method and every other figure are in [`bench/results.json`](bench/results.json). Rerun with `kiri bench`.

## How it works

```
docker CLI ─┐
compose ────┼─ Docker Engine API ─► kiri daemon ── vsock ──► guest agent (PID 1)
buildx ─────┤                         owns the VM           clone3 → container
kiri UI ────┘
```

The VM uses a custom 10 MB kernel, and its PID 1 is a ~900 KB Rust agent.
That agent starts containers with a single `clone3` into namespaces and a
cgroup. There's no runc, no shim and no dockerd. More detail is in
[docs/development.md](docs/development.md#architecture).

## Documentation

- [Features](docs/features.md): everything supported today, release files and known issues
- [Development](docs/development.md): building, running from source, architecture and repository layout
- [Release notes](docs/releases)

## Roadmap

Next is a built-in builder. Kiri will serve Docker's own build endpoints, so
buildx uses its docker driver against Kiri as it does against Docker
Desktop. This brings `host-gateway` support to BuildKit builds, and images
load straight into Kiri.

## Contributing

Issues and pull requests are welcome. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md)
and the [Code of Conduct](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md). To report a vulnerability
privately, see [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).

## License

[Apache-2.0](LICENSE). Third-party licences are in [NOTICE](NOTICE). The guest
kernel is Linux (GPL-2.0); its config, patches and the source offer are in
[`guest/kernel`](guest/kernel).

The name "Kiri" and the Kiri logo are not covered by the licence. Forks are
welcome, under a different name and logo.

Battery levels of your wireless mouse, headset, keyboard and controller, right on the Windows taskbar.

![Wireless Battery on the taskbar](docs/screenshot.png)

> **Just want it working?** Download **[WirelessBattery-Setup](https://github.com/krisgfx9/Wireless-Device-Battery-Monitor/releases/latest)** from the latest release, run it and click through. That's it.
>
> **Experienced users** can grab the portable zip, use the [command-line options](#command-line), or [build it from source](#build) with `make` or `build.bat`.
>
> **Like it?** Wireless Battery is free and open source. If it saves you a trip into vendor software, you can support it on [Ko-fi](https://ko-fi.com/krisgfx), [PayPal](https://www.paypal.com/paypalme/krisgfx) or [GitHub Sponsors](https://github.com/sponsors/krisgfx9). It helps me keep my apps free alongside my studies. Not able to donate? A ⭐ star, sharing it, or reporting an unsupported device with a `--dump` helps just as much.

- **Tiny**: a ~350 KB app using about 2 MB of RAM. It's plain C++/Win32, with no runtime and no background service, and installs in seconds without admin rights.
- **No vendor software needed**: it talks to the devices directly. G HUB, Synapse, iCUE, GG and NGenuity can stay closed (or keep running; they don't conflict).
- **Many brands**: Logitech, Razer, SteelSeries, Corsair, HyperX, Glorious, Jabra, JBL, PlayStation and Xbox controllers, Samsung Galaxy Buds, any Bluetooth device Windows knows a battery level for, and every headset the bundled [HeadsetControl](https://github.com/Sapd/HeadsetControl) supports.

## Display

**On the taskbar (default):** `🎧 30%  🖱 93%` next to the notification area, drawn with the Windows icon font.
- **Low battery:** a red number means 15% or less.
- **Charging:** a blue ⚡ appears next to the number.
- **Asleep:** dimmed text means the device is asleep and the last known value is shown.
- **Theme:** it follows light/dark mode and DPI scaling.
- **Transparent taskbar themes** (e.g. Windhawk's Taskbar Styler): turn on *Background behind taskbar text* in the menu to keep the text readable over the wallpaper.

**Tray icons:** one icon per device with the number drawn in it, plus a "Low battery" notification at 15%. The app switches to this automatically when the taskbar is vertical or can't be found.

Hover for details. Click for the menu: every device (click one to hide or show it), display mode, *Refresh now*, *Start with Windows*, and *Exit*. Levels refresh every 60 seconds, and right away when a device is plugged in or the PC wakes up.

oss.readme:
简体中文 · English

  
    
    
  

  DeepSeek Harness 的手机应用：Android 版已发布；iOS 版仍在开发和真机测试，需在 Mac 上自行签名编译（iOS 工程 · 架构）。

  
  
  
  

  
  Trendshift 全语言日榜 #1 · 2026-10-30

Deepy 和鲸娘，陪你干活

干活时敲代码，做完来个空翻，等你确认会举手。打开「App 外显示」，它们还会跟你到桌面。

     

     

下载 DSH Go

从 GitHub Releases 或官网下载页获取最新版 APK，常见手机选 arm64 包。

   

  感谢大家对 DSH Go 的支持和喜爱！当前下载页提供 Android APK；iOS 版还在开发和真机测试，没有公开安装包，鸿蒙版也在继续推进。

  

  第一次用可以先看使用指南，遇到问题欢迎来论坛和 QQ 群。
  手机上装过签名不同的早期测试包时不能直接覆盖安装，需要先卸载旧版；卸载会清空对话、Linux 环境和设置。

本机运行，也能遥控电脑

内置 Linux 环境，免 Root、免 Termux。电脑上的 DSH，也能一键切过去接着用。

  
    
    
  

插话、打断，过程自动收好

回复中途也能插话，排队的消息随时「立即发送」。做完的过程折叠成一行。

  
    
    
  

原生界面，也有网页版

和官方网页版一键切换，停在同一段对话，下次打开还是你上次用的那个。

  
    
    
  

分享卡、对话回放和链接

回复一键做成分享卡。整段对话生成链接，对方在浏览器里回放，链接端到端加密。

  
    
    
  

横屏与平板

横屏手机和平板重新排版：侧栏常驻，内容居中，弹出键盘也不挤。

  
    
    
  

主题配色与桌面图标

六套主题色，也能跟随壁纸或自选颜色。四款桌面图标，三种功能图标风格。

  
    
    
  

中文，也说 English

全部界面支持英文，在设置里切换，默认跟随系统。

  
    
    
  

手机操控

看屏幕、帮你点，三档确认随你选。敏感操作默认交还给你；放宽应用规则或解除限制前，请先了解风险。

  
    
    
  

## 可以做什么

DSH Go 提供聊天界面、本机运行环境和远程连接，是基于 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 的第三方项目。运行在手机上的是 DSH 引擎；模型请求仍由你配置的模型提供方处理。

- **本机运行**：在 App 内安装 Ubuntu、Node.js 与 DSH 运行环境，无需 Root 或另装 Termux。
- **远程连接**：通过 SSH 或李国宝老师开发的 [DSHarness Remote](https://github.com/liguobao/ds-harness-remote) 使用电脑、服务器上的 DSH。
- **聊天与工具**：切换模型，发送图片、使用语音输入，处理工具审批和提问；支持聊天界面与网页模式。
- **插件界面**：使用适配 DSH Go 的原生工具卡、表单和面板；仓库提供 SDK、教程和示例。
- **手机操控**：在你开启权限后，让本机引擎读取屏幕、点按和输入，并可随时停止。
- **分享与外观**：分享、导出和回放对话，调整主题、图标和桌宠。

功能随主机和连接方式不同。DSHarness Remote 当前只支持图片附件，不能在 App 内打开网页版，插件管理限于开关，且不支持 DS Bot 和对话日志导出。详见[本机引擎与远程主机](docs/guide/zh/03-engine-hosts.md)。

## 安装

安装要求为 Android 8.0（API 26）及以上。Release 页面上的 **arm64** 安装包适用于常见的 64 位 Android 手机；x86_64 设备和模拟器用的 x64 包在发布说明末尾的「其他版本下载」里。仓库没有 32 位 ARM 构建。

1. 从 [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-go/releases/latest) 或[官网下载页](https://go.dshtui.com/download)下载对应架构的 APK，并按系统提示允许该安装来源。
2. 首次启动时，选择在本机安装运行环境，或连接远程主机。
3. 为所选主机配置模型和所需凭据，再开始对话；部分远程渠道需要在主机侧配置。

仅连接远程主机时，不必在手机上安装本机运行环境。手机操控只对正常模式下的本机引擎开放，需要按界面说明开启无障碍等权限；不打扰模式另外要求 Android 14 及以上，以及 Shizuku 或自连 ADB。首次使用可按[使用指南](docs/guide/README.md)逐项配置。

本地引擎默认使用 PRoot 兼容启动。开发者选项中的直接启动默认关闭，开启后的兼容性和回退方式见[常见问题](docs/guide/zh/11-faq.md)。当前 Android 构建以 APK 侧载为目标，不是 Google Play 发布配置。

“发送匿名使用统计”默认开启，可在首次引导或“设置 → 隐私与分享”关闭。采集范围和关闭后的处理见[常见问题](docs/guide/zh/11-faq.md)。分享内容前，请检查预览；收到链接或文件的人可以保存其中的内容。

## 常见问题

和 DeepSeek 官方是什么关系？

没有关系。DSH Go 是社区开发的非官方客户端，基于开源的 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 构建。手机上运行的是 DSH 本身；模型请求发给你配置的模型提供方，需要联网，按你在提供方的账户计费。

安全吗？

本机网页版只接受 App 自己的访问。分享链接端到端加密，密钥只在链接里，服务器看不到内容，但获得完整链接的人可以读取并保存内容。手机操控默认保留敏感操作保护；放宽应用规则或开启「解除限制」会减少这些保护。安全机制不能保证零风险，详见[风险提示与免责声明](#风险提示与免责声明)和[手机操控指南](docs/guide/zh/04-phone-control.md)。

部分系统的省电策略会拦住后台。DSH Go 发现后会提醒你，并直达对应的放行设置，vivo、小米、华为、荣耀、OPPO 都有。

Android 8 及以上。手机直接下载 Release 页面上的安装包即可，模拟器用的 x86_64 版在发布说明末尾的「其他版本下载」里。在手机上运行 DSH 要先准备内置的运行环境，请预留约 1 GB 空间；只连电脑或服务器上的 DSH 可以不装。

## 从源码构建

以下流程面向 **Linux x86_64**。当前工具链脚本默认安装 JDK 17、Flutter 3.47.7 和 Android SDK/NDK；App 要求 Dart `^3.13.5`。准备 Bash、Git、curl、tar、unzip、xz、Python 3、zstd（Python 未提供 `compression.zstd` 时用于解包 zstd 压缩的 deb）、file 和常见 GNU 命令；重新解析 Ubuntu 软件包锁时还需要 gpgv。

先取得完整源码和项目资源。`app/pubspec.yaml` 声明的字体、图片等都是构建输入，运行时包由下面的脚本生成。

```bash
git clone https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-go.git
cd dsh-go

bash tooling/setup-toolchain.sh
source tooling/env.sh
flutter --version
java -version

bash runtime/build-runtime.sh arm64-v8a
DSH_BETA_TOKEN_FILE= bash tooling/build-apk.sh -f arm64 --keep-daemon
```

工具链脚本会下载 SDK/NDK 与模拟器镜像，并执行 Android SDK 许可接受步骤。默认安装到 `~/dev`；可通过 `DEV_ROOT` 指定独立目录。脚本会复用已有安装，构建前请核对版本。

产物为 `app/build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-arm64-release.apk`。运行时构建使用仓库固定的版本与校验信息，并需要联网下载依赖。示例中的 `DSH_BETA_TOKEN_FILE=` 不嵌入维护者的内测通道令牌；`--keep-daemon` 保留 Gradle daemon，适合同时开发其他 Android 项目的环境。

构建 x86_64 包时，先生成对应运行时：

```bash
bash runtime/build-runtime.sh x86_64
DSH_BETA_TOKEN_FILE= bash tooling/build-apk.sh -f x64 --keep-daemon
```

未配置 `app/android/key.properties` 时，本地 release 构建使用 debug 签名。它不能直接覆盖不同签名的官方安装包；请在测试设备上安装，保留已有数据，不要为解决签名冲突直接卸载正在使用的 App。发布签名与密钥文件不要提交到仓库。

只查看 APK 构建命令，可运行：

```bash
DSH_BETA_TOKEN_FILE= bash tooling/build-apk.sh --dry-run -f all
```

> [!NOTE]
> **ArtCraft is a community of artists from all walks of life.** Painters, photographers,
> filmmakers, illustrators, designers, animators, hobbyists, and people who picked up a pencil
> last week. If you make things, you're one of us. **[Come say hi on Discord](https://discord.gg/artcraft).**

  How it works ·
  Two ways to use it ·

      🔍 Study anything
      Websites, desktop apps, phone apps, games and files: real inspection tools find out how they're built and what they do, with the evidence behind every answer.
    
    
      🛠️ Build your own
      Say what you want ("Recreate this website", "Recreate this game's gameplay in Rust") and a coding agent builds a new project in the stack you ask for.
    
    
      ✅ Checked, not guessed
      Every build is compared with the original (pages at three screen widths, a game's own self-test, an app's runs) and refined until it's close.
    
    
      🤖 Agent-ready
      320 tools, each one a CLI command and an MCP tool, so any agent can drive the same engine the app uses. No AI is needed to inspect.
    
  

## How it works

Point Craft Anything at a target, say what you want, and press Start. It works in four steps,
asking you in plain words when a decision is yours:

1. **Study:** inspect the original: its pages at every width, its code, its files, how it runs.
2. **Build:** a coding agent builds a new project, in the language, framework or engine your
   request names (or a sensible default).
3. **Check:** compare the build with the original and list what doesn't match yet.
4. **Ready:** open, play or preview the result, or ask for changes and it refines it.

  
    
      
      Make: pick what to recreate, say what you want, press Start.
    
    
      
      Ready: play the game, or ask for changes below.
    
  

## Two ways to use it

- **Simple** (default): "What do you want to make?" Pick a website, app or game, describe it,
  press Start. A project page shows the four steps (Study → Build → Check → Ready), what the
  agent is doing in plain words, question and approval cards, how alike the result is, and
  buttons to open the result or its folder. Ask for changes in the box at the bottom.
  "Just look inside" opens a target for questions without building anything (in Deep mode).
- **Advanced**: the full workbench: every tool (Ctrl/Cmd+K), functions, strings, pseudo-C,
  disassembly, hex, call graphs, evidence, unknowns, jobs, logs and the agent console.

Both modes drive the same engine.

## Clean room or Deep

- **Clean room** (the default): nothing inside the original is read, not its code, files or page
  source. Craft Anything works from what you can see: pictures you add, the website as a visitor
  sees it (screenshots, visible text, measured layout, colours, fonts and spacing, menus opened)
  and, when you allow it, a picture of the app's window. Tools that would look inside are refused
  and say how to turn on Deep mode.
- **Deep**: every tool is used, for your private use. A program's code and files are read with the
  built-in engines (and Ghidra when it's installed), a website's JavaScript is read and its start
  page watched, and the builder may use all of them.

Clean room is a rule about what Craft Anything offers and refuses. It is not an operating-system
sandbox: it doesn't isolate your computer. A coding agent you run still acts as you, and what it can
read, write or run depends on its own permissions. Which of an agent's own tools Craft Anything can
refuse differs by agent; for Claude Code's tools in chats and questions, see
[`docs/claude-code.md`](docs/claude-code.md).

Switch in the title bar or Settings, with `settings_set deep_mode true`, or for one CLI run with
`--deep` (or `--clean-room`).

  
  
  Advanced: functions, pseudo-C, the agent and the evidence behind every answer.

## AI

Building needs a coding agent on your computer. **Claude Code** is supported first: Craft
Anything runs your own, unmodified `claude` program, which uses your own sign-in; Craft Anything
never sees or handles your account. Your use of it falls under your own agreement with
Anthropic. See [docs/claude-code.md](docs/claude-code.md) for how and why. A Codex adapter
exists but hasn't been verified on a real install yet. **GitHub Copilot** can use your installed
Copilot CLI through ACP: sign in separately with `copilot login`. **Grok Build** can use your
installed `grok` program through ACP (`grok agent stdio`): sign in separately with `grok login`.
See [docs/grok.md](docs/grok.md). Other agents that speak ACP (Gemini CLI,
Qwen Code, opencode, goose, Hermes, Maki, Devin) can be switched to it per backend; of those, Maki
and Devin have been run live (Devin authenticates with the backend's stored key — its own CLI
sign-in doesn't count over ACP). Anthropic, OpenAI, OpenRouter, xAI (Grok, when `XAI_API_KEY` is
set) and local OpenAI-compatible servers are available for questions and analysis (Settings → AI).

# ApkStart

[![CI](https://github.com/RoutineMiku/apkstart/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/RoutineMiku/apkstart/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/RoutineMiku/apkstart?include_prereleases&sort=semver)](https://github.com/RoutineMiku/apkstart/releases)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![Platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/platform-Windows%2010%2F11%20x64-0078D6.svg)](#)

**Windows 上的安卓应用运行器 —— 让安卓应用像 Windows 原生软件一样被安装和使用。**
注：本项目为早期版本，作者自娱自乐产物，所有修改都是作者下班和休息日在处理，开源免费，不插广告，暂时也不是很好用，没有找过营销号推广，无妄之灾。

- 🖱️ **双击 .apk 即安装**：注册 .apk 文件关联后，在资源管理器里双击 APK，自动解析 → 安装 → 生成桌面图标，全程无需打开任何模拟器界面。
- 🧩 **每个应用一个桌面图标**：图标从 APK 内部离线提取并转为多尺寸 ICO，双击桌面图标 = 直接启动该应用，与打开一个原生 Windows 软件的体验一致。
- 🪟 **应用就是一个窗口**：运行时以**带窗口**模式启动（无头模式下 Android 不出 VSYNC，应用进程活着但屏幕上是空的），ApkStart 把这块窗口改标题、换真实应用图标、按竖屏比例摆好位置，就是一个独立应用窗口；**全屏**铺满屏幕高度并居中，**窗口模式**可自由拖动缩放且按应用记忆尺寸。
- 🔍 **能被 Windows 搜到**：安装后同时创建桌面 + 开始菜单（`程序\ApkStart\`）快捷方式，按应用名在开始菜单搜索即可直达，任务栏按应用分组。
- 📁 **数据互通**：`%USERPROFILE%\ApkStartShared` ↔ 安卓内 `/sdcard/ApkStartShared` 持续双向同步，安卓应用存下的文件直接出现在本机。
- 🪶 **极致轻量**：壳层本身零第三方依赖（连 ZIP / PNG / ICO / AXML 解析都是手写的），运行时按需拉起，空闲自动回收；也可以完全复用你机器上已有的安卓运行时，额外占用为零。

![主界面](docs/images/app.png)

```
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  桌面图标（真实应用图标 .lnk）                              │
│      │  双击                                               │
│      ▼                                                     │
│  ApkStart.exe --launch                               │
│      │  运行时未启动？→ 自动拉起（Android Emulator + API34）│

## 下载即用（不想编译）

两个源内容一致，国内建议用 Gitee：

- GitHub：[github.com/RoutineMiku/apkstart/releases](https://github.com/RoutineMiku/apkstart/releases)
- Gitee：[gitee.com/daily-miku/apkstart/releases](https://gitee.com/daily-miku/apkstart/releases)（国内直连快得多）

安装包（三种形态，内容与版本号完全一致）：

| 形态 | 文件名 | 何时选它 |
|---|---|---|
| 商店版 | `ApkStart__x64.msix` | 从 Microsoft Store 装。内置完整运行时，装完不联网；自更新交给商店 |
| 完整便携版 | `ApkStart-v*-win64-full.zip`（约 830 MB，解压 ~1.3 GB） | **不想装、也不想等下载**：解压即用，运行时（模拟器 + 系统镜像）全在包里 |
| 安装版 | `ApkStart-v*-Setup.exe`（约 1.3 GB） | 想要桌面/开始菜单快捷方式、卸载项 |
| 轻量便携版 | `ApkStart-v*-win64-portable.zip`（96 MiB，解压 ~227 MB） | 只想先试试，首次启动再联网下载运行时 |

> 所有形态的 `ApkStart.exe` 都写入了**品牌图标 + 版本资源**（FileDescription = `ApkStart 安卓应用运行器`，
> CompanyName = `RoutineMiku`，版本与 `package.json` 同步），不再是 Electron 的默认图标和 `33.x` 版本号。
> 自己从源码打包时：`npm run pack`（轻量）/ `npm run pack:full`（完整）/ `npm run build:msix`（商店包）。

### 画面铺满是怎么做到的

模拟器的**物理面板方向**（`hw.lcd.width/height`）就是画面的真实形状。面板方向和应用自己声明的
`screenOrientation` 不一致时，Android 只会给应用一个信箱式的中间窄条 —— 两侧补黑，换窗口大小、
改 `wm size`、改 letterbox 样式都填不满（这套组合逐项试过，见 `src/core/apk.js` 的注释）。

所以 ApkStart 在**安装 APK 时离线解析 `AndroidManifest.xml`**，统计出这个应用天然是横屏还是竖屏
（启动 Activity 加权；全 `sensor` / `fullSensor` 的会在首次运行后再问安卓要一次实际值），存进
`apps.json`，启动时按它选面板：

- 红果短剧这类竖屏应用 → 竖屏面板 720×1280，正立、铺满、density 190（sw606dp）同时给出平板排版；
- 墨读这类横屏应用 → 横屏面板 1280×720，正立、铺满。

只有「面板方向和应用方向不一致」的那一次才重启运行时（约 40 秒，标题栏会给出提示），
之后同方向的应用都是秒进。标题栏的旋转按钮会把这个应用的方向**记住**（其它应用不受影响），
设置 → 应用窗口 → 屏幕方向可以改成「强制横屏 / 强制竖屏」。

排版由「逻辑密度」决定：720 宽按 190dpi 算等于 **606dp**，正好越过 Android 的 600dp 平板断点，
红果短剧的双列剧集页、设置页分栏都只在这个密度下出现（镜像默认 320dpi 只有 360dp，是手机排版）。
这就是设置里的「平板排版」开关，默认打开；关掉会回到手机排版。

### 在线更新（自动选较快的源）

设置 → **软件更新** → 「检查更新」，或托盘右键 → 「检查更新」。发现新版本后点「立即更新」即可。

- 安装版下载 `ApkStart-v*-Setup.exe` 静默安装；
- 轻量版下载 `ApkStart-v*-win64-portable.zip`，解压后覆盖**程序目录**——运行时目录（`%APPDATA%\apkstart\runtime`）、已装应用与快照都不在程序目录里，所以更新不会丢东西；
- 替换动作由一段独立 PowerShell 脚本完成（等主进程退出 → 覆盖 → 重新拉起），**不会出现「请手动关闭程序」的弹窗**，也不会在桌面上残留模拟器窗口。

更新链路不是死连 GitHub，而是**每次现测现选**：

1. 同时问 GitHub 与 Gitee 的最新版本，取版本号更高的那个（一个源超时/被墙不影响另一个）；
2. 把「源站直连 / Gitee 同名资产 / 镜像前缀」列成候选，每个地址真下 256KB 测速，
   只算「收到首字节之后」的吞吐（握手时间不计入，否则高延迟大带宽的源会被误判成慢）；
3. 按实测速度排序，用最快的那条分块并行下载；失败自动换下一条。

设置里的「下载与更新源」可以强制只用某一边（企业网络只放行一个域名时用），
也可以关掉公共加速镜像、或改用自建镜像前缀。Gitee 附件单文件上限 100MB，
便携包换用 7-Zip 的 deflate（`-mx=9`）压缩后是 **95.0MB**，所以 Gitee 上也是
一个能直接双击解压的整包（以前要切成 `.part1/.part2` 手工拼接，那版已经废弃）。
两个源的同名包体积并不完全一样，客户端按测速结果只挑一个源下完，不会混拼。

两个仓库都是公开的，Gitee 的发行版列表匿名就能读，不需要填任何 token。
（只有在 Gitee 限流返回 403/429 时，才需要在设置里填一个只读 token 提高额度。）

**开箱即有的默认行为**（不用去设置里找）：

- 开机自动启动，常驻托盘；双击桌面图标直接进应用。
- 安装 APK 后自动创建**桌面 + 开始菜单**两份快捷方式，Windows 搜索能直接搜到应用名；老版本漏建的会在启动时自动补齐。
- 应用窗口是原生渲染（非投屏）：**全屏**铺满屏幕高度并居中、保持手机比例不变形；**窗口模式**保持竖屏，可自由拖动缩放，每个应用的尺寸单独记忆。随时按 `F11` 或右键托盘切换。
- 安装后自动授予应用申请的运行时权限，不会卡在系统授权框；应用闪退会自动重试、必要时重置应用数据后再拉起。
- **网络直接用主机的网络**：安卓侧走 QEMU 用户态 NAT，出口复用主机的物理网卡，**不会在 Windows 上创建任何虚拟网卡 / 虚拟交换机**（不需要装驱动、也不多一个网络适配器）。不需要联网下载、不需要改任何网络设置。

## 从源码构建

```powershell
# 1. 安装依赖（含 Electron 运行时）
npm install

# 2. 启动并完成运行时部署（一次性下载 adb / Android Emulator / 系统镜像）
npm start

# 3.（可选）注册 .apk 双击安装
npm run assoc:on

# 4. 打包便携版（免安装，可直接分发）
npm run pack
# 产出 dist/ApkStart-win64-portable/ApkStart.exe
# 5. 压成 zip 发布（必须用这个脚本，别用 Compress-Archive：体积会大 5MB、塞不进 Gitee）
node build/zip.js dist/ApkStart-win64-portable ApkStart-win64-portable.zip
```

### 单文件 EXE（内置完整运行时，装完不再联网）

如果希望「一个 EXE 发出去，对方双击就能跑，不用等下载」，用这条：

```powershell
# 先把 engine/ 整理成可分发运行时（system.img 用 xz/LZMA2 极限压缩，3.1GB → 约 1.1GB；
# 同时裁掉 emulator 里用不到的部分：arm64 的 QEMU、Vulkan 后端、多语言包、qsn/自检工具、VR 资源）
npm run runtime

# 再打成安装版 EXE（electron-builder nsis 目标，装到当前用户目录）
npm run build:exe
# 产出 dist/release/ApkStart--Setup.exe
```

体积构成（实测）：Electron 约 180MB、emulator 瘦身后约 480MB、系统镜像 xz 压缩后约 1.1GB，
最终安装包约 1.32GB（相比 gzip 方案省约 490MB）。能再压的硬下限就在 system.img 那条
（它就是安卓系统本身，且是 verity 保护的镜像，无法从外部裁掉 GMS 组件）。
网络默认走主机 NAT，不创建虚拟网卡，所以也不依赖任何额外驱动。

首次启动会把 xz 镜像展开到 `%APPDATA%\apkstart\system-images`（约 20 秒，只做一次），
之后每次直接复用。AVD 与已装应用固定存放在 `%APPDATA%\apkstart\avd`，
即使便携版每次解压到临时目录也不会丢。

## 运行时说明：完全独立，不依赖任何第三方模拟器

ApkStart 是一个**自持**的项目，运行时组件全部由自己下载、校验和管理（位于 `%APPDATA%\apkstart\runtime`）。
轻量版默认从**

# Mister Download Manager

  

Downloads faster than IDM. Free, forever.

  86 languages · no ads, no trial, no sign-up

  
    5×Fastera 1 GB file: 1 s instead of 5.5 s
    +46More languages86 instead of IDM's 40
    100%Cheaper (free!)no licence, no trial, ever
    TorrentSupported fullymagnet links, .torrent files, seeding
  

  
    
    
  

  
  
  
  
  
  
  

| 🚀 [Download](#download) | ⚡ [Why switch](#why-switch-from-idm) | 🖼️ [Screenshots](#screenshots) | ✨ [Getting started](docs/getting-started.md) | 📜 [Help and tutorials](docs/README.md) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |

## Why switch from IDM?

**Same window you know. Your downloads finish sooner. And it costs nothing.**

  
    
    
  

| | Mister Download Manager | IDM 6.42 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Download a big file (1 GB) | **1 second** | 5.5 seconds |
| Download a small file | **instantly** | 3.1 seconds |
| Download over a shaky connection | **1.6 seconds** | 5.4 seconds |
| Wait before a download starts | **instantly** | 3.1 seconds |
| Price | **Free, forever** | Paid, after a 30-day trial |
| Ads, nag screens, sign-up | **None** | Registration needed |
| Open source | **Yes** (GPL) | No |

Nothing new to learn: the toolbar, the categories, the list of downloads, the progress window and
the browser button are where you expect them. Measured on the same computer, same files, both
programs at their default settings ([how we measured](#the-benchmark-in-detail)).

## Download

  
  
  

On the [download page](https://github.com/anefzaoui/misterdownloadmanager/releases/latest), pick
one:

| File | Choose it when |
| --- | --- |
| **`...-setup.exe`** | **Not sure? Take this one.** It installs MDM, connects it to your browser and asks your language. |
| `...-portable.zip` | You want MDM on a USB stick or without installing: unzip and run. Everything stays in its folder. |
| `...-x64.zip` | You want the plain programs without an installer. |
| `...-setup-arm64.exe`, `...-portable-arm64.zip`, `...-arm64.zip` | The same three for **Windows on ARM** (Snapdragon and other ARM PCs). |
| `...-setup-x86.exe`, `...-portable-x86.zip`, `...-x86.zip` | The same three for **32-bit Windows 10**. There, choose your own ffmpeg in **Helpers** for the best video qualities: none is built for it that MDM can check. |
| `...-extension-chromium.zip` | You want to add the browser extension by hand (Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Vivaldi). From the stores is easier: [Add to Chrome](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/mister-download-manager/ejoleppdfgjdndddcjoehopknmlglojp), [Add to Firefox](https://addons.mozilla.org/firefox/addon/mister-download-manager/). |

The ARM64 and 32-bit files come with every release after 0.5.2; **Check for updates** keeps each
copy on its own processor's files.

> [!NOTE]
> Windows may say *"Windows protected your PC"* the first time, because this early version isn't
> code-signed yet. Click **More info**, then **Run anyway**.

Or with [WinGet](https://learn.microsoft.com/windows/package-manager/winget/), Windows' package
manager: in a terminal, the first line installs MDM and the second updates it.

```
winget install AhmedNefzaoui.MisterDownloadManager
winget upgrade AhmedNefzaoui.MisterDownloadManager
```

### On Linux

MDM runs on Linux too, tested on Ubuntu 24.04, Debian 12 and Fedora with GNOME, KDE Plasma, Xfce
and Cinnamon, on X11 and in Wayland sessions: the tray, dark mode, browser integration (Ubuntu's
Snap Firefox included) and the packages' installs. Not there yet: screen readers (Orca) don't
read its windows, and Flatpak browsers can't reach it ([more](docs/getting-started.md#on-linux)).
Up to version 0.2.4, the files' names end in `-experimental`.

| File | For |
| --- | --- |
| `...-linux-x86_64.deb` | Ubuntu, Debian, Mint, Pop!_OS: `sudo apt install ./.deb`. |
| `...-linux-x86_64.rpm` | Fedora, openSUSE, RHEL: `sudo dnf install ./.rpm`. |
| `...-linux-x86_64.AppImage` | Any Linux. Make it executable and run it. |
| `...-linux-x86_64.tar.gz` | The plain programs, for any distribution. |
| `...-linux-arm64.*` | The same four for 64-bit ARM computers, from the release after 0.5.2 (built and tested on GitHub's ARM machines). |

  
    
    
  

### On a Mac? Be the first to try it

Fresh builds for **macOS** (Apple Silicon and Intel) are on the same download page, marked
`-experimental`: we haven't tried them on a Mac ourselves yet. Give them a go and
[tell us how it went](https://github.com/anefzaoui/misterdownloadmanager/issues/new/choose); you'll
help make them as solid as the Windows and Linux versions.

| File | For |
| --- | --- |
| `...-macos-arm64-experimental.dmg` | Mac with Apple Silicon (M1 or later). Open it and drag MDM to Applications. The first time, right-click the app and choose **Open**. |
| `...-macos-x86_64-experimental.dmg` | Mac with an Intel processor, the same way. |

## 🌍 In your language

Every language Windows 11 offers, **86 in all**. MDM asks on its first start, and you can change
it any time in **View → Language**. Arabic, Hebrew, Persian, Urdu and Uyghur get a fully mirrored,
right-to-left window.

## Screenshots

  
    One click on YouTube: the Download video button appears over the video.
    Any video on any page: drag the button where you like, it stays there.
  
  
    Watch it fly: every connection's share of the file, live speed and time left.
    Dark mode that follows Windows.
  
  
    Add a download: paste a link, or let MDM catch it from your browser.

releases.name: sdk-v1.10.0
releases.body:
### Features

* **api:** add beta support for the billing_policy request parameter
* **api:** add contract_spend_limit_reached error code to messages
* **api:** add error codes for linked billing refusals
* **api:** add the user_profile_billing_not_authorized error code
* **api:** add webhook events for external key failure and recovery


### Bug Fixes

* **tools:** keep the session tool runner's maxIdleMs countdown running when a session thread terminates

  If the runner fails to read the session's event history after a reconnect, a termination that then arrives on the event stream still cancels the countdown, until the next idle or successful read.

* **tools:** stop EnvironmentWorker from running tools for a terminated session

  For a terminated session, the worker now force-stops the work item right after it retrieves the session, before it downloads skills or memory stores. It no longer throws `SessionMemoryError` for such a session. The API reports an archived session as `terminated`.

* **tools:** stop the session tool runner from running the tool calls of a terminated session thread

  The runner also stops waiting for a confirmation of these calls and no longer yields them, including a denied call (`confirmation: 'deny'`) and a call to a tool that it does not own. A call that the runner starts before it reads the session thread's `session.thread_status_terminated` event still runs to the end, and the runner yields it with `posted: false` when the API refuses the result.


### Chores

* **api:** rename error data models, deprecating the old names
* **docs:** clarify which AWS KMS keys a workspace can use on Claude Platform on AWS
* **docs:** clarify which credential work get, update and list accept
* **docs:** clarify which uploads a plugin pin holds back
* **docs:** note that a plugin scan's reason also covers errored scans

  `content_scan.reason` on an errored scan now says why there is no verdict. It is not a security finding, so code that treats any `reason` as a concern should also check `status`.

releases.body:
### Features

* **api:** add source and error codes to the RBAC Role read endpoints
* **api:** add Update Bundle, which sets a Claude Tag Bundle's instructions, and return instructions on Bundle


### Bug Fixes

* **helpers:** keep $schema out of the transformed schema description
* **streaming:** reject characters that aren't JSON in streamed tool input

  The lenient parser for streamed tool input used to skip characters and words that aren't JSON, such as a comment, and to join numbers such as `12 3`, so it could return a value that the text doesn't contain. It now rejects such text, and a stream with such tool input fails with an error, as it already did for a bad escape or a missing comma. Valid and truncated JSON parse as before.

* **tools:** bound the grep tool's search at 60s where ripgrep is missing, and keep its regex off the main thread
* **tools:** compare directory names exactly when confining file paths on Windows
* **tools:** fully resolve file tool paths that pass through a dangling symlink
* **tools:** ignore ripgrep config files in the agent toolset grep tool
* **tools:** leave symlinks that point outside /memories out of listings
* **tools:** normalize file modes of extracted skill files

  Extracted files now get `0644`, or `0755` if any execute bit is set, in `0700` directories, whatever the archive recorded. The system `tar` must accept `--no-same-owner` and `--no-same-permissions`.

* **tools:** pass over a tar or unzip inside the directories the agent toolset's file tools can write

  `setupSkills` takes `tar`, `unzip` and a helper that `tar` starts, such as `gzip`, only from the `PATH` entries outside `workdir` and `allowedRoots`, and passes over a link that leads inside them. A host whose only `tar` or `unzip` is inside those directories can no longer download skills until one is installed outside. Only when no `PATH` entry is outside them, as with a `workdir` of `/`, is all of `PATH` still searched. A `tar` or `unzip` that fails now rejects with an `AnthropicError`.

* **tools:** pass over an rg inside the directories the agent toolset's file tools can write

  `grep` passes over an `rg` that resolves to somewhere inside `workdir` or `allowedRoots`. It uses the next `rg` on `PATH`, or the built-in search when there is none. With a `workdir` that holds every `rg` on the host, such as `/`, every search is a built-in search. `rg`, and the `tar` and `unzip` that extract skills, no longer get the `ANTHROPIC_*` variables of the process, like the shell of `bash`.

* **tools:** read memory files only through the path that was validated
* **tools:** stop looking for rg, tar and unzip in the current directory
* **tools:** stop the grep tool's built-in search at a NUL byte in a file

  The built-in search of `grep` reads no further into a file once it meets a NUL byte, much as ripgrep does. A very large binary file with no line break used to end the process with an uncaught `RangeError`.

* **api:** deprecate old bet

releases.name: wrangler@4.164.0
releases.body:
### Minor Changes

- [#16450](https://github.com/cloudflare/workers-sdk/pull/16450) [`5f05841`](https://github.com/cloudflare/workers-sdk/commit/5f05841d4d4a4a67fee5ddc0150309b5ed782069) Thanks [@xortive](https://github.com/xortive)! - Add custom CA and client certificate references to Workers VPC service TLS settings

  Workers VPC (open beta) service create and update commands accept `--certificate-authority` and `--client-certificate` UUIDs. Use either flag alone or both together. Whenever you supply either reference, explicitly choose `--cert-verification-mode`:

  - `verify_full`: verify the origin certificate chain and hostname (the platform default).
  - `verify_ca`: verify the chain but skip hostname verification, weakening origin identity checks.
  - `disabled`: do not verify the origin certificate; this allows connections to impersonated origins and is unsafe for production.

  For HTTP services, these settings apply to HTTPS connections, not plaintext HTTP. TCP services can use them for upstream TLS, including PostgreSQL.

  TLS settings are per-service only: host and resolver networks have no TLS settings or inheritance. Omitting TLS settings uses platform defaults (certificate chain and hostname verification). Explicit mode-only configuration, including `verify_full`, is accepted. A custom CA cannot be combined with `disabled`; a client certificate without a custom CA can.

  Upload certificates using the existing commands, then use the returned IDs below. Replace `<ca-uuid>`, `<client-uuid>`, `<tunnel-uuid>`, and service IDs with your own values; certificate references must be valid UUIDs. Upload replacement certificates the same way before rotating their references.

  ```sh
  pnpm exec wrangler cert upload certificate-authority --ca-cert ./ca.pem --name private-ca
  pnpm exec wrangler cert upload mtls-certificate --cert ./client.pem --key ./client-key.pem --name private-client
  ```

  Create an HTTPS service with both a custom trust chain and an mTLS client certificate, or a PostgreSQL TCP service with only a custom CA:

  ```sh
  pnpm exec wrangler vpc service create private-web \
    --type http --https-port 443 --ipv4 10.0.0.10 --tunnel-id <tunnel-uuid> \
    --certificate-authority <ca-uuid> --client-certificate <client-uuid> \
    --cert-verification-mode verify_full

  pnpm exec wrangler vpc service create private-db \
    --type tcp --tcp-port 5432 --app-protocol postgresql \
    --hostname db.internal.example --resolver-ips 10.0.0.53 --tunnel-id <tunnel-uuid> \
    --certificate-authority <ca-uuid> --cert-verification-mode verify_full
  ```

  For client-certificate-only configuration, use `--client-certificate <client-uuid> --cert-verification-mode verify_full` instead of the certificate flags in either create command.
